title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first two-dimensional sketch, draw the first face by creating a loop that starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0), extends horizontally to (0.025, 0.0), moves vertically to (0.025, 0.75), returns horizontally to (0.0, 0.75), and finally closes back to the origin. For the second face, create another loop starting at (0.6187, 0.0), extending horizontally to (0.6437, 0.0), moving vertically to (0.6437, 0.75), returning horizontally to (0.6187, 0.75), and closing back to the starting point. Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.025 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular prism. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism are a length of 0.6437499980080543, a width of 0.7500000101792865, and a height of 0.024999999922642884.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the first face
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .close()

# Define the second face
r = r.moveTo(0.6187, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.6437, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.6437, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.6187, 0.75) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.025)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Two thin parallel bars running along the Y axis
bar_w = 0.025   # width along X
bar_t = 0.025   # thickness along Z
bar_len = 0.75  # length along Y
total_x = 0.6437

bar1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(bar_w, 0.0)
    .lineTo(bar_w, bar_len)
    .lineTo(0.0, bar_len)
    .close()
    .extrude(bar_t)
)

bar2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(total_x - bar_w, 0.0)
    .lineTo(total_x, 0.0)
    .lineTo(total_x, bar_len)
    .lineTo(total_x - bar_w, bar_len)
    .close()
    .extrude(bar_t)
)

r = bar1.union(bar2)

import cadquery as cq

# Two parallel square-section rails
rail_w = 0.0250   # X width
rail_l = 0.7500   # Y length
rail_t = 0.0250   # Z thickness
overall_x = 0.6437

rail = cq.Workplane("XY").box(rail_w, rail_l, rail_t, centered=(False, False, False))

r = rail.union(rail.translate((overall_x - rail_w, 0, 0)))
